analysis_disclosure: Gemini E4 (0/112) and E5 (0/96) are dev-ceiling results; neither is bought as a scored judge. Harm contrasts: no harm observable at ceiling. Good approval is gated only in A, V, W, R and E4 F_correct; F and U are excluded by design.
